feeds.title: Data Centre & Network News Magazine
feeds.description: Data Centre & Network News (DCNN) is the total solution at the heart of the data center and networking industry. The industry uses DCNN to keep up to date with industry news, product developments, insight, analysis, and opinions concerning all the popular topics surrounding the industry.

feeds.title: Roger Perkin Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Roger a UK-based network consultant, I am CCIE in Routing & Switching. This is my Network Engineer Blog covering my CCIE Journey and now Network Automation with Ansible & Python. Tutorials and posts are added weekly. If you are a network engineer and like reading blogs then click on through and learn something new!

feeds.title: Squire Technologies Blog
feeds.description: Squire Technologies Blog is about SS7, VoIP & VoLTE Carrier-grade gateways with expert global service and support. Follow us to keep up with articles on SS7 VoIP Media Gateways, VoIP Softswitch, Session Border Controller, Media Gateway Controller, SS7 ISDN Protocol Converters, SMS Gateways & Wholesale Billing Solutions.

feeds.title: ADVA
feeds.description: Technically Speaking is an online community for those interested in the networking industry. Within these pages, you will find insight and comments on the latest hot topics and industry concerns. Written by industry experts, this blog is designed to engage discussion and drive thought.
